status: Closed — close-window restore and delivery-gate reporting repaired; re-verified 2026-09-02
area: taskflow close --write rolls back once, then a byte-identical retry succeeds
finding: Observed twice in one session on two unrelated cards. The first taskflow close --write returns ATM_TASKFLOW_CLOSE_WRITE_ROLLED_BACK after its backend has already reported ATM_TASKS_CLOSED; the ledger is correctly restored; the same command, re-run with no argument change and no state change by the operator, then completes with ATM_TASKFLOW_CLOSE_WRITE_ORCHESTRATED. No mechanism is claimed here — this record exists so the next person to hit it has two payloads instead of a rumour. The reason it is filed as High despite being self-recovering is behavioural: a gate that a bare retry passes teaches operators to retry gates, and from the operator's side that is indistinguishable from a gate that means nothing.
expectedBehavior: A close that will succeed on retry should succeed the first time. If the first attempt is doing preparatory work that only the second can consume — writing a manifest, reconciling the live index, settling a lock — that is a two-phase operation and should either complete both phases or report which phase it completed and what the retry will do, rather than reporting a rollback that reads as a refusal.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0365, 2026-08-13T16:00Z: first --write returned ATM_TASKFLOW_CLOSE_WRITE_ROLLED_BACK with commitBundle.failClosed true, while its own backendResult carried ATM_TASKS_CLOSED; the identical retry sealed as 1f2674a50. ATM-GOV-0366, 2026-08-13T16:57Z: same first-attempt code with the same three --historical-delivery refs, same lane, same actor; the identical retry sealed as 94ae4e895. Between attempts the operator ran no command in either case. Both first-attempt payloads were captured at the time.
followUp: Resolved by cd725c54f, which retries close-window index restoration while preserving durable recovery identity, and by 87a52ef3b, which preserves the backend delivery-gate result in close-write reporting. Re-verified on 2026-09-02: taskflow-close-window-lock and mixed-delivery-close-ux both pass. This closure does not claim that every future external Git/index failure is retry-free; it closes the observed no-input-change retry path. No frozen-runner publication or task-card closeout is claimed by this backlog-only closure.
